description: This file defines a class `HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Multiple` responsible for handling validation of CSS properties that accept multiple comma-separated values, such as 'margin' or 'border-width'. It manages multiple values by multiplying a single value validation and enforcing a maximum number of values.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_AttrDef_CSS_Multiple
classes.description: A class to handle validation and processing of CSS properties with multiple values, allowing a maximum number of entries, usually four.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the single value attribute and maximum number of values allowed.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a string containing multiple CSS property values, parsing and validating each individual value using the 'single' attribute, and respecting the maximum number of allowable values.
